annotations.title: Re-check a value against its upstream source

description: Re-reads the upstream API behind one of our values right now and reports where the same number appears in the upstream response (JSONPath), the relative difference, and a verdict: exact, within_1pct, within_10pct, no_matching_field or not_checkable_by_get. Use it to check a figure before relying on it. Makes one GET to a third-party API; read-only.
